SELECT
  p.id AS pair_id,
  p.mentee_name,
  p.mentee_email,
  p.mentor_name,
  p.mentor_email,
  p.cohort_start_date,
  GREATEST(1, LEAST(52, (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) + 1)) AS current_week,
  CASE
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 13 THEN 1
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 26 THEN 2
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 39 THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END AS current_quarter,
  qc.id AS cycle_id,
  COALESCE(qc.status, 'no_cycle') AS cycle_status,
  COALESCE(qc.meeting_confirmed_mentee, FALSE) AS confirmed_mentee,
  COALESCE(qc.meeting_confirmed_mentor, FALSE) AS confirmed_mentor,

  -- Has mentee submitted goals this quarter? (used for Q1 reminder/escalation)
  COALESCE((
    SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM table_2 g
    WHERE g.pair_id = p.id
      AND g.quarter = CASE
        WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 13 THEN 1
        WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 26 THEN 2
        WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 39 THEN 3
        ELSE 4 END
      AND g.submitted_by = 'mentee'
  ), FALSE) AS mentee_goals_submitted,

  -- Has mentor submitted support plan this quarter? (used for Q1 reminder/escalation)
  COALESCE((
    SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM table_2 g
    WHERE g.pair_id = p.id
      AND g.quarter = CASE
        WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 13 THEN 1
        WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 26 THEN 2
        WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 39 THEN 3
        ELSE 4 END
      AND g.submitted_by = 'mentor'
  ), FALSE) AS mentor_goals_submitted,

  -- Has mentee submitted feedback/check-in this quarter? (used for Q2/Q3/Q4 reminder/escalation)
  COALESCE((
    SELECT f.submitted_at IS NOT NULL
    FROM table_3 f
    WHERE f.cycle_id = qc.id
      AND f.submitted_by = 'mentee'
    LIMIT 1
  ), FALSE) AS mentee_feedback_submitted,

  -- Has mentor submitted year-end review this quarter? (used for Q4 reminder/escalation)
  COALESCE((
    SELECT f.submitted_at IS NOT NULL
    FROM table_3 f
    WHERE f.cycle_id = qc.id
      AND f.submitted_by = 'mentor'
    LIMIT 1
  ), FALSE) AS mentor_feedback_submitted

FROM table_4 p
LEFT JOIN table_5 qc
  ON qc.pair_id = p.id
  AND qc.quarter = CASE
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 13 THEN 1
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 26 THEN 2
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 39 THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END
WHERE p.pair_status = 'active'
  AND p.mentor_email IS NOT NULL
  AND p.mentor_email != ''
  AND p.cohort_start_date <= NOW();

parameters.query:
SELECT
  t.pair_id,
  t.cycle_id,
  t.person_email,
  t.person_role,
  t.used,
  t.expires_at,
  p.mentee_name,
  p.mentor_name,
  p.mentee_email,
  p.mentor_email,
  qc.quarter,
  f.ai_questions,
  f.id AS feedback_id,

  -- Determine form type from table_12 and role
  CASE
    WHEN qc.quarter = 1 THEN 'q1'
    WHEN qc.quarter IN (2, 3) THEN 'q2q3'
    WHEN qc.quarter = 4 THEN 'q4'
  END AS feedback_type,

  -- Outstanding goals — only relevant for mentee in Q2/Q3/Q4
  -- Pull goals that have NOT been completed in any previous quarter
  CASE
    WHEN t.person_role = 'mentee' AND qc.quarter > 1 THEN (
      SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('index', g.goal_index, 'text', g.goal_text))
      FROM (
        SELECT 1 AS goal_index, g.goal_1 AS goal_text
        FROM table_2 g
        WHERE g.pair_id = t.pair_id AND g.submitted_by = 'mentee'
          AND g.goal_1 IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM table_11 gc
            WHERE gc.pair_id = t.pair_id AND gc.goal_index = 1
          )
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 2, g.goal_2
        FROM table_2 g
        WHERE g.pair_id = t.pair_id AND g.submitted_by = 'mentee'
          AND g.goal_2 IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM table_11 gc
            WHERE gc.pair_id = t.pair_id AND gc.goal_index = 2
          )
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 3, g.goal_3
        FROM table_2 g
        WHERE g.pair_id = t.pair_id AND g.submitted_by = 'mentee'
          AND g.goal_3 IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM table_11 gc
            WHERE gc.pair_id = t.pair_id AND gc.goal_index = 3
          )
      ) g
    )
    ELSE NULL
  END AS outstanding_goals

FROM table_8 t
JOIN table_4 p ON p.id = t.pair_id
JOIN table_5 qc ON qc.id = t.cycle_id
JOIN table_3 f
  ON f.cycle_id = t.cycle_id
  AND f.submitted_by = t.person_role
WHERE t.token = $1
  AND t.used = FALSE 
  AND t.token_type = 'feedback_submission'
  AND t.expires_at > NOW();

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cycles_pair             ON HR_MentorMe_Cycles(pair_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_goals_pair              ON HR_MentorMe_Goals(pair_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_feedback_cycle          ON HR_MentorMe_Feedback(cycle_id);

-- ### Key Schema Design Notes

-- `HR_MentorMe_Pairs.status` vs `pair_status`:** The `status` column is a legacy field that always equals `'active'`. The operative status is `pair_status` (`pending | active | completed`). All queries should filter on `pair_status`.

-- `HR_MentorMe_Feedback.ratings`:** Stores Q4 structured ratings as JSONB. Keys are prefixed `r_mentor_*`, `r_mentee_*`, and `r_prog_*`. Empty `{}` for Q1/Q2/Q3.

-- `HR_MentorMe_Escalations`:** One record per escalation event per week. The `week_triggered` column is used for deduplication — the system checks `column_4 X column_25 current_week` to ensure only one escalation fires per pair per Monday.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  p.id                          AS pair_id,
  p.mentee_name,
  p.mentee_email,
  p.mentor_name,
  p.mentor_email,
  p.cohort_name,
  p.pair_status,
  p.cohort_start_date,

  -- Current quarter/week
  GREATEST(1, LEAST(52, (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) + 1)) AS current_week,
  CASE
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 13 THEN 1
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 26 THEN 2
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 39 THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END                           AS current_quarter,

  -- Current quarter cycle
  qc.id                         AS cycle_id,
  qc.status                     AS cycle_status,
  qc.meeting_confirmed_mentee,
  qc.meeting_confirmed_mentor,
  qc.meeting_confirmed_at,

  -- Escalations (all time)
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_27 e
   WHERE e.pair_id = p.id)      AS escalation_count,

  -- Goals: mentee goals text (most recent quarter)
  (SELECT json_build_object(
    'goal_1', g.goal_1,
    'goal_2', g.goal_2,
    'goal_3', g.goal_3,
    'additional_context', g.additional_context,
    'quarter', g.quarter,
    'submitted_at', g.submitted_at
  ) FROM table_2 g
  WHERE g.pair_id = p.id AND g.submitted_by = 'mentee'
  ORDER BY g.quarter DESC LIMIT 1) AS mentee_goal,

  -- Goals: mentor support plan text (most recent quarter)
  (SELECT json_build_object(
    'additional_context', g.additional_context,
    'quarter', g.quarter,
    'submitted_at', g.submitted_at
  ) FROM table_2 g
  WHERE g.pair_id = p.id AND g.submitted_by = 'mentor'
  ORDER BY g.quarter DESC LIMIT 1) AS mentor_support_plan,

  -- Goals submitted counts
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_2 g
   WHERE g.pair_id = p.id AND g.submitted_by = 'mentee') AS mentee_goals_quarters_submitted,

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_2 g
   WHERE g.pair_id = p.id AND g.submitted_by = 'mentor') AS mentor_support_plans_submitted,

  -- Goal completions (all time)
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_11 gc
   WHERE gc.pair_id = p.id)     AS goals_completed_count,

  (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('quarter', gc.quarter, 'goal_index', gc.goal_index))
   FROM table_11 gc
   WHERE gc.pair_id = p.id)     AS goals_completed_detail,

  -- Feedback: all submissions across all quarters
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_3 f
   WHERE f.pair_id = p.id AND f.submitted_at IS NOT NULL) AS feedback_submitted_total,

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_3 f
   WHERE f.pair_id = p.id AND f.submitted_by = 'mentee' AND f.submitted_at IS NOT NULL) AS mentee_feedback_count,

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_3 f
   WHERE f.pair_id = p.id AND f.submitted_by = 'mentor' AND f.submitted_at IS NOT NULL) AS mentor_feedback_count,

  -- Learning logs submitted (mentee only)
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_3 f
   WHERE f.pair_id = p.id AND f.submitted_by = 'mentee'
   AND f.learning_log IS NOT NULL AND f.learning_log != '') AS learning_logs_count,

  -- Q4 mentor review submitted
  (SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM table_3 f
   WHERE f.pair_id = p.id AND f.submitted_by = 'mentor'
   AND f.quarter = 4 AND f.submitted_at IS NOT NULL) AS mentor_q4_review_submitted,

  -- Per-quarter cycle summary (all 4 quarters)
  (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    'quarter', qall.quarter,
    'status', qall.status,
    'meeting_confirmed_mentee', qall.meeting_confirmed_mentee,
    'meeting_confirmed_mentor', qall.meeting_confirmed_mentor,
    'meeting_confirmed_at', qall.meeting_confirmed_at
  ) ORDER BY qall.quarter)
  FROM table_5 qall
  WHERE qall.pair_id = p.id)    AS all_cycles,

  -- Last activity (latest of any submission)
  GREATEST(
    (SELECT MAX(g.submitted_at) FROM table_2 g WHERE g.pair_id = p.id),
    (SELECT MAX(f.submitted_at) FROM table_3 f WHERE f.pair_id = p.id AND f.submitted_at IS NOT NULL),
    qc.meeting_confirmed_at
  )                             AS last_activity_at,

  -- End of quarter flag (current cycle unconfirmed with ≤2 weeks left)
  CASE
    WHEN (
      (qc.status IS NULL OR qc.status = 'pending')
      AND (
        CASE
          WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 13 THEN 13
          WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 26 THEN 26
          WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 39 THEN 39
          ELSE 52
        END - GREATEST(1, (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) + 1)
      ) <= 2
    ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
  END                           AS end_of_quarter_flag

FROM table_4 p
LEFT JOIN table_5 qc
  ON qc.pair_id = p.id
  AND qc.quarter = CASE
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 13 THEN 1
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 26 THEN 2
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 39 THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END
WHERE p.pair_status IN ('active', 'pending')
  AND p.cohort_start_date <= NOW()
ORDER BY p.cohort_name ASC, p.mentee_name ASC;

-- Dashboard metrics
SELECT
  'metrics' AS query_type,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_4 column_22 'active') AS active_pairs,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_4 column_22 'pending') AS pending_pairs,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_4 column_22 'completed') AS completed_pairs,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mentor_email) FROM table_4 column_22 'active') AS active_mentors,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_5 column_14 'confirmed' column_14 'feedback_sent') AS meetings_confirmed,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_5 column_14 'escalated') AS escalations,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_3 WHERE submitted_at IS NOT NULL) AS feedback_submitted,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_2) AS goals_submitted,
  (SELECT cohort_name FROM table_16 column_14 'pending' ORDER BY start_date ASC LIMIT 1) AS next_cohort_name,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_4 column_22 'pending') AS next_cohort_pending_pairs;

SELECT
  mp.email,
  mp.name,
  mp.department,
  mp.location,
  mp.role,
  mp.is_active,
  mp.profile_submitted,
  mp.cohort_mentee_count,
  mp.personal_statement,
  -- How many active pairs this mentor currently has
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_4 p
   WHERE p.mentor_email = mp.email
     AND p.pair_status IN ('active','pending')) AS paired_mentee_count,
  -- Total escalations across all their mentees
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sub.esc),0) FROM (
    SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_27 e WHERE e.pair_id = p2.id) AS esc
    FROM table_4 p2
    WHERE p2.mentor_email = mp.email
      AND p2.pair_status IN ('active','pending')
  ) sub) AS total_escalations,
  -- Meetings confirmed this quarter across their mentees
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_4 p
   JOIN table_5 qc ON qc.pair_id = p.id
     AND qc.quarter = CASE
       WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 13 THEN 1
       WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 26 THEN 2
       WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 39 THEN 3
       ELSE 4 END
   WHERE p.mentor_email = mp.email
     AND p.pair_status IN ('active','pending')
     AND qc.meeting_confirmed_mentor = TRUE) AS meetings_confirmed,
  -- Support plans submitted
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_2 g
   JOIN table_4 p ON p.id = g.pair_id
   WHERE p.mentor_email = mp.email
     AND g.submitted_by = 'mentor') AS support_plans_submitted,
  -- Q4 reviews submitted
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_3 f
   JOIN table_4 p ON p.id = f.pair_id
   WHERE p.mentor_email = mp.email
     AND f.submitted_by = 'mentor'
     AND f.quarter = 4
     AND f.submitted_at IS NOT NULL) AS q4_reviews_submitted
FROM table_14 mp
WHERE mp.is_active = TRUE
ORDER BY mp.name ASC;

SELECT
  md.email,
  md.name,
  md.department,
  md.location,
  md.role,
  md.cohort_name,
  md.status                         AS directory_status,
  -- Pair info (null if not paired)
  p.id                              AS pair_id,
  p.mentor_name,
  p.mentor_email,
  p.pair_status,
  p.cohort_start_date,
  CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN
    GREATEST(1, LEAST(52, (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) + 1))
  END                               AS current_week,
  CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN
    CASE
      WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 13 THEN 1
      WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 26 THEN 2
      WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 39 THEN 3
      ELSE 4
    END
  END                               AS current_quarter,
  qc.status                         AS cycle_status,
  qc.meeting_confirmed_mentee,
  qc.meeting_confirmed_mentor,
  qc.meeting_confirmed_at,
  -- Escalations
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_27 e
   WHERE e.pair_id = p.id), 0)      AS escalation_count,
  -- Goals
  (SELECT json_build_object(
    'goal_1', g.goal_1, 'goal_2', g.goal_2, 'goal_3', g.goal_3,
    'additional_context', g.additional_context,
    'quarter', g.quarter
  ) FROM table_2 g
  WHERE g.pair_id = p.id AND g.submitted_by = 'mentee'
  ORDER BY g.quarter DESC LIMIT 1)  AS mentee_goal,
  -- Support plan
  (SELECT json_build_object(
    'additional_context', g.additional_context,
    'quarter', g.quarter
  ) FROM table_2 g
  WHERE g.pair_id = p.id AND g.submitted_by = 'mentor'
  ORDER BY g.quarter DESC LIMIT 1)  AS mentor_support_plan,
  -- Goal completions
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_11 gc
   WHERE gc.pair_id = p.id), 0)     AS goals_completed_count,
  (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('quarter', gc.quarter, 'goal_index', gc.goal_index))
   FROM table_11 gc
   WHERE gc.pair_id = p.id)         AS goals_completed_detail,
  -- Feedback
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_3 f
   WHERE f.pair_id = p.id AND f.submitted_by = 'mentee'
   AND f.submitted_at IS NOT NULL), 0) AS mentee_feedback_count,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_3 f
   WHERE f.pair_id = p.id AND f.submitted_by = 'mentee'
   AND f.learning_log IS NOT NULL AND f.learning_log != ''), 0) AS learning_logs_count,
  -- All cycles
  (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    'quarter', qall.quarter, 'status', qall.status,
    'meeting_confirmed_mentee', qall.meeting_confirmed_mentee,
    'meeting_confirmed_mentor', qall.meeting_confirmed_mentor,
    'meeting_confirmed_at', qall.meeting_confirmed_at
  ) ORDER BY qall.quarter)
  FROM table_5 qall
  WHERE qall.pair_id = p.id)        AS all_cycles,
  -- Last activity
  GREATEST(
    (SELECT MAX(g.submitted_at) FROM table_2 g WHERE g.pair_id = p.id),
    (SELECT MAX(f.submitted_at) FROM table_3 f WHERE f.pair_id = p.id AND f.submitted_at IS NOT NULL),
    qc.meeting_confirmed_at
  )                                 AS last_activity_at
FROM table_15 md
LEFT JOIN table_4 p
  ON p.mentee_email = md.email
  AND p.pair_status IN ('active','pending')
LEFT JOIN table_5 qc
  ON qc.pair_id = p.id
  AND qc.quarter = CASE
    WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 13 THEN 1
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 26 THEN 2
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 39 THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END
WHERE md.status NOT IN ('graduated','exited')
ORDER BY md.name ASC;
